items.t: Port Moody real estate market stats

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Heritage Woods?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 18 houses and 6 condos and townhomes listed in Heritage Woods. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Heritage Woods a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 22% (a sellers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Heritage Woods from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 11 houses and 4 condos and townhomes sold in Heritage Woods over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in September with 4 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 3 sold.

faq.q: How big is Heritage Woods compared with the rest of Port Moody?
faq.a: In September 2026, Heritage Woods held 13.3% of the 135 detached houses listed in Port Moody and 3.1% of the 192 condos and townhomes listed in Port Moody.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Heritage Woods?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 75.0% of the 24 homes listed in Heritage Woods and condos and townhomes made up 25.0%; of the 4 that sold, houses were 100.0% and condos and townhomes 0.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Heritage Woods than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 20 to 18 (−10.0%) and condos and townhomes rose from 3 to 6 (+100.0%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
